production_rule: A channel is production only when production_eligible is true, it has a published identifier, and every required gate is passed with retained acceptance evidence for the exact published artifact.

required_gates.requirement: verified publisher identity and policy attestations
production HTTPS MCP endpoint and completed domain verification
successful current MCP tool and skill scans
complete public listing metadata and legal/support URLs
five passing positive cases and three passing negative cases
reviewer test account, demo recording, and release notes
directory approval and owner-controlled publication
immutable reviewed Git ref designated as the stable channel
published package provenance and checksum
clean install and upgrade acceptance on each supported OS
downgrade, rollback, revocation, and second-device acceptance
documented support window and compatibility range
Chrome Web Store developer account and reviewed listing
single-purpose, permission, privacy, and limited-use declarations
store-managed installation and automatic update acceptance
published-version upgrade and rollback acceptance
clean device migration and revocation acceptance
Partner Center developer account and certified listing
complete purpose, permission, data-use, and privacy declarations
store-managed installation and automatic update acceptance
published-version upgrade and rollback acceptance
clean device migration and revocation acceptance

findings: MCP initialize reports serverInfo.version 0.1.0 instead of the packaged manifest version 0.2.0.
Windows rollback and restoration acceptance is open after plugin-cache backup failed with access denied.
Windows 11 restored the exact tagged marketplace and loaded codex@syndicatum 0.2.2 with the expected tools, connector, and protected identity.

Exact-byte provenance failed for 41 text files because the Git marketplace checkout converted LF to CRLF under core.autocrlf=true; initialize, fresh-task health, adversarial isolation, and same-version recovery evidence also remain incomplete.

Windows 10 and Windows 11 verified the exact tagged marketplace and installed package bytes, expected tool catalog, protected public identity continuity, project-scoped reads, and live connector ownership; Windows 10 also captured serverInfo.version 0.2.3 from the installed server in isolated temporary state.
Background health was only a startup snapshot without a heartbeat or age gate; no safe cross-project negative fixture was available and same-version recovery remains unexercised.

Windows 10 and Windows 11 verified exact release and installed bytes, the 38-tool catalog, protected identity and project scope, live listener ownership, advancing heartbeat timestamps, and fail-closed background-manager stale-health detection.
Installed PluginRuntime.currentStatus still reported top-level ready for a nested stale_health background, so aggregate connector status did not fail closed.

Windows 10 verified exact release and installed bytes, the 38-tool catalog, protected identity and project scope, listener ownership, advancing heartbeat, and end-to-end stale_health propagation through PluginRuntime.currentStatus.

Windows 11 found that a connector-configuration watcher replaced live running status with a configured-only object, dropping route counters to zero while aggregate status still reported ready; real delivery attempts also failed because the bound target thread had no rollout.

Windows 10 and Windows 11 verified exact release and installed bytes, the 38-tool catalog, protected project-scoped identity and reads, listener ownership, recovered nonzero routes, advancing heartbeat, and installed-code reload and fail-closed health behavior.
Active routed delivery remains open, and a modern new-agent claim can be blocked before contacting Syndicatum when the checkout contains the obsolete pbb-chat-token.local.json format.

installed_acceptance.production_blocker: The accepted package was loaded unpacked; Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons publication and store-managed update acceptance remain open.

compatibility.planned_support_policy: Once production support is established, it covers the current stable Codex plugin release only after promotion and the immediately previous promoted stable release. A published but unpromoted predecessor does not create a support entitlement.
compatibility.note: Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 are the owner-approved initial targets, not yet production support claims. The production range, supported operating systems, and support window remain unclaimed until the exact tagged installation, update, rollback, migration, and revocation acceptance is retained for each claimed operating system.
